tspan.tspan: Climate change is intensifying extreme wind events across Central Europe, imposing demands that exceed the design assumptions of GDR-era Plattenbau buildings — prefabricated reinforced-concrete panel structures built between 1960 and 1990. Commercial Structural Health Monitoring (SHM) systems remain prohibitively expensive, reliant on proprietary platforms, and operate as black-box solutions
